cases.title: Stop, expiry, End task and revoked authority
cases.recommendation: Keep server policy recheck immediately before every dispatch; no offline command replay.

cases.title: Workflow Customer → Note → Opportunity saved journey
cases.recommendation: Eleven real WebSocket commands saved/read back three local records; policy adapter is simulated there. Actual Flolah runner is tested separately. One fresh signed-in Flolah workflow run and CRM foreign-key linkage are not proved by this combined evidence.

cases.title: Maker/checker functional and failure routes
cases.recommendation: Maker-only/passive routes pass at 2048 tokens. The actual shared Ollama route offered Express for review in 94 seconds, but its cited-summary request failed closed at the 180-second checker deadline. Polling now remains bounded; this independent checker issue remains open with screenshot evidence.

cases.title: Visible stages, elapsed progress and Stop
cases.recommendation: HTTP abort releases real capacity; Stop cancels remaining effects and never undoes a dispatched write.

cases.title: Typed editable and rejectable reviews
cases.recommendation: Nine representative editor types pass; every revision revalidates structure and invalidates old approval.

cases.title: Persistent errors, action notices and accessibility
cases.recommendation: Chrome keyboard and notices pass. Full screen-reader announcement validation is explicitly deferred by the user on 19 October; it is not an implementation partial.

cases.title: Separate panel, task, group and counterpart state
cases.recommendation: Lifecycle/session/pairing tests and explicit connection copy pass; ended private context is not resurrected.

cases.title: Sender, recipient and workflow-run trace consistency
cases.recommendation: Recipient completion now waits for coordinator acknowledgement. A fresh live Flolah run screenshot must close the three-surface UI comparison.

cases.title: Held-out language and intelligent clarification
cases.recommendation: Typos, checkbox language, radio intent, default plurals, preserve-current, unavailable choice, advice and cited summary pass. Broader comparisons/conflicting/missing-fact language is not fully measured.

cases.title: Fresh owner email sign-in and empty registration
cases.recommendation: Simulated clean-owner flow passes. Existing registrations were reused as requested, so a new real inbox/owner registration was not tested.

cases.title: Real DNS ownership and challenge recovery
cases.recommendation: Missing/wrong/renewed challenge and race guards pass in the resolver fixture. No new real DNS TXT change was made.

cases.title: Actual installation, origin and diagnostics
cases.recommendation: Both authorized live origins initialize; expiry/origin/CSP error contracts remain covered. Installed tokens are not published in screenshots.

cases.title: Persisted discovery and cross-site isolation
cases.recommendation: Persistence/isolation regressions pass. Reusing existing registrations does not prove one fresh owner discovered an entirely new site unassisted.

cases.title: Teach → task test → publish → fresh visitor replay
cases.recommendation: Actual consumed/observed proposal evidence gates task-tested readiness, and publication carries only unchanged tested steps. Full UI teaching-to-fresh-visitor chain remains open.

cases.title: Owner setup resumption and website isolation
cases.recommendation: Server state, ownership and paging regressions pass; live owner logout/login plus two-account browser resumption remains unperformed.

cases.title: Disable/revoke invalidates readiness and execution
cases.recommendation: Server revocation and policy-at-dispatch tests pass. Complete the owner UI disable/revoke → visitor UI refusal chain.

cases.title: No domain-specific backend seeding
cases.recommendation: Clean self-service fixture asserts empty content. Existing live registrations have historical operator setup; that history cannot be relabelled unseeded.

cases.title: 25 websites and concurrent real planning workload
cases.recommendation: 500 management requests: zero errors, 112.97 ms p95; 25 tasks/50 recipients pass. Concurrent inference queue/stage/search-memory capacity remains unmeasured.

cases.title: Bounded multi-format parsing and private memory
cases.recommendation: 25 real text files / two workers pass, with zero retained extraction bytes or cleanup backlog. A new concurrent PDF+image workload is still required.

cases.title: Real 24-hour retention elapsed deletion
cases.recommendation: Immediate ended-task denial and actual ISM policy passed previously. Verify physical deletion after its real elapsed cycle; do not shorten the shared policy to manufacture a pass.

cases.title: Desktop keyboard plus deferred devices/assistive tech
cases.recommendation: Desktop Chrome passes. The user explicitly deferred real Safari/iOS, Android and full screen-reader checks on 19 October. These are excluded from the active certification scope until resumed.

scope: Only existing loopback fixture and public flolah.cloud as website targets. No public form submission, login or laptop exposure. Flolah signed-in consoles are control-plane checks. Fixtures and actual model/live UI layers are separate, explicitly labelled.
history: Initial radio-fixture error, missing Linux test packaging helpers, startup health-probe/line-ending issues, two deterministic checker parsing faults, 700-token verdict instability, overlapping field-label dependency and choice-order false continuation were retained/repaired. Map-context testing also caught literal branch-name copying instead of its documented servicing code and an editor accessible-label mismatch; these were fixed and verified. The earlier failed real-model map results are retained. Final results below supersede failed attempts for their exact executed scope; historical failures are not erased.
